newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's AirOne starts operating Milan-Naples route.
newsitem.headline: Italy's AirOne starts operating Milan-Naples route.

text.p: Italian private airline AirOne on Friday started operating on the Milan to Naples route after receiving official authorisation.
The company said in a statement it planned three flights a day in each direction.
In the first 10 months of this year, the airline carried a total 542,000 passengers, of which 375,000 were on its Milan-Rome route.
AirOne, which launched a shuttle service between Milan and Rome in November last year, was the first airline to provide regular competition on the route against loss-making national carrier Alitalia.
AirOne has a fleet of eight Boeing 737s.
